test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Amir, Bunty, Leslie, Pradeep, Eshan, Faiz, Gaurav and Harish are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Pradeep sits third to the right of Gaurav. Pradeep sits at one of the corners. Bunty sits second to the right of Faiz. Faiz does not sit at any of the corners. Bunty is not an immediate neighbour of Pradeep. Harish is an immediate neighbour of Amir. Harish does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. Only one person sits between Harish and Leslie.

Who sits third to the right of Amir?
solution:
**Amir, Bunty, Leslie, Pradeep, Eshan, Faiz, Gaurav and Harish** are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

1. Pradeep sits third to the right of Gaurav.

2. Pradeep sits at one of the corners.

3. Bunty is not an immediate neighbour of Pradeep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/111435d8ea3257683c2998f60aee7faa5d61f31d76b67a81e725f8a1c925e6d9.png] 

4. Faiz does not sit at any of the corners. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fcd469856405609cb9169673ebd27029f52baaae691c5e7e26219283adf5577.png] 

5. Bunty sits second to the right of Faiz.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c86e6811e6f8dcbfd752a58533b95b2be5348fb3746e1de76ab15b73ef687919.png] 

6. Harish is an immediate neighbour of Amir.

7. Harish does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7908cf519ffffb38dba88cdb2f11d50ed308f8667f9e02bb1df88ed43d144049.png] 

8. Only one person sits between Harish and Leslie.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e64f1a78d065131da30ef6889cbc09812a719fd0b6d24b9c38dec62f58c130d8.png] 

Eshan the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e369b43c843b3e60af58b5b162eff5ed540c154f5053cdfa67294db8f5b8c27.png] 

Clearly, Eshan sits third to the right of Amir.

Hence, ‘**Eshan**’ is the correct answer.
